nodes.title: Hand off review URL
nodes.description: The coding agent hands the local review URL it prepared to the reviewer.

nodes.title: Review diagrams and sources
nodes.description: The reviewer inspects the process and design diagrams and opens the source evidence they need.

nodes.title: Comment on a diagram
nodes.description: The reviewer leaves a comment at the relevant spot on a diagram.

nodes.title: Send a follow-up request to the coding agent
nodes.description: The reviewer sends the coding agent a follow-up request based on the review results.

nodes.title: Artifact change detected
nodes.description: File polling and SSE notify the open workspace of artifact changes.

nodes.title: Is the changed artifact valid?
nodes.description: The server validates the new artifact's JSON, schemas, and diagram composition.

nodes.title: Keep the last valid artifact
nodes.description: When the change is invalid, show the error and keep the current artifact.

nodes.title: Activate the new revision
nodes.description: Compute the revision ID of the whole valid artifact and replace the current review.

nodes.title: Show the updated artifact
nodes.description: Show the new diagrams and exclude comments from the previous revision from the current canvas.

nodes.title: External comment change detected
nodes.description: The open review's comment file changes or is deleted outside the app.

nodes.title: Is the user editing a comment?
nodes.description: Workspace compares the external document with the current comment edit state.

nodes.title: Apply external comment changes
nodes.description: With no local edit, apply the latest comment content to the canvas.

nodes.title: Show conflict options
nodes.description: When the comment being edited has changed, prompt for a choice between the external comment and the local draft.

nodes.title: Continue the review with the chosen content
nodes.description: Apply the reviewer's choice and offer comment editing and saving again.

nodes.title: Receive an architecture review request
nodes.description: The coding agent starts preparing a review for the designated consumer scope.

nodes.title: Discover available generators
nodes.description: The agent harness discovers built-in, global, and project generator manifests.

nodes.title: Write the artifact
nodes.description: Write artifact.json following the common writing rules, the chosen generator's guidance, and the schemas.

nodes.title: Run the Architecture Companion server
nodes.description: Start the server for the designated scope and print the loopback URL.

nodes.title: Does validate-schemas accept the artifact?
nodes.description: The coding agent validates the candidate artifact with the validate-schemas command.

nodes.title: Fix artifact errors
nodes.description: Fix the artifact from the validation errors and rerun the command until it prints Artifact is valid.

nodes.title: Hand off review URL
nodes.description: Explain what the validated artifact covers and hand the review URL to the reviewer.
